question: How many accidents did the driver who had the highest number accidents in the Canadian Grand Prix have?
evidence: number of accidents refers to the number where statusid = 3; Canadian Grand Prix refers to the race of name
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(T1.driverId) FROM results AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 on T1.raceId = T2.raceId INNER JOIN status AS T3 on T1.statusId = T3.statusId WHERE T3.statusId = 3 AND T2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' GROUP BY T1.driverId ORDER BY COUNT(T1.driverId) DESC LIMIT 1

fail_candidates.candidate_sql:
SELECT MAX(accident_count) 
FROM (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) as accident_count
    FROM results r
    JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
    WHERE r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE name = 'Canadian Grand Prix')
    AND s.statusId = 3
    GROUP BY driverId
)

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS accident_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        r.driverId,
        COUNT(*) AS driver_accident_count
    FROM races ra
    JOIN results r ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
        AND r.statusId = 3
    GROUP BY r.driverId
    ORDER BY driver_accident_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accident_count FROM (
    SELECT T1.driverId 
    FROM races AS T2 
    JOIN results AS T1 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId 
    WHERE T2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND T1.statusId = 3 
    GROUP BY T1.driverId 
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)
